# Order questions

The assistant can explain general delivery, return, warranty, payment, and assembly policies. It cannot view a customer's live order, edit delivery instructions, cancel an order, reserve inventory, or confirm a transaction.

For order-specific help, provide the order reference to a manager through the approved support flow. Do not post addresses, payment details, or account credentials in general chat. A request for status is informational until a manager accesses the relevant order system.
